center: One photo → every angle (but still the same person)
surveyNote: From my survey of 15 papers on single-portrait novel view synthesis (categories and paper names only).

groups.title: Warp the original photo
groups.good: Keeps the real pixels, so the face stays very much itself.
groups.bad: Only small turns — anything the photo never saw can't be invented.

groups.title: 3D GAN inversion
groups.good: A real 3D-aware generator, so every angle is geometrically consistent.
groups.bad: Squeezing a photo into the GAN's space can lose who the person is.

groups.title: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction
groups.good: One pass, fast enough to feel instant.
groups.bad: Fine details depend on what the network saw in training.

groups.title: Diffusion-based
groups.bad: The face can drift into someone else.
